AssetActionSrcPriceAdjustment.name: AssetActionSrcPriceAdjustment
AssetActionSrcPriceAdjustment.description: Each row represents a junction between an asset and the calculated price adjustment that's applied to an asset.

AdjustmentValue.description: The value of the price adjustment that was applied to the asset.

AppliedPriceAdjustmentDate.description: The date and time on which the price adjustment was applied to the asset.

AssetActionSourceId.description: The ID of the asset action source related to the asset for which the price adjustment was applied.

AssetId.description: The ID of the asset that this price adjustment applies to.

Name.description: The name of the asset price adjustment record.

PriceAdjustmentCauseId.description: The ID of the record that caused the price adjustment.

PriceAdjustmentSource.description: Specifies the source of price adjustment.

PrioritySequence.description: The priority sequence of the applied price adjustment.
